CLOUD REVIEWER seat for PR #2844 of tvofi/heatpump_optimizer, at head ac96f4c35659dd3c99f6155b6290cf437ce7742f. Bus nonce: 212a1c44640251bec096b192f77b6627. Never send push notifications. Write no Claude Code footer, no Co-Authored-By or Claude-Session trailer and no claude.ai session link in any commit, pull-request body or comment you produce; check your commits with `git log --format=%B` before pushing.
Setup: `git fetch --unshallow --tags origin`. The toolchain (venv python, node, gh) is on PATH from the environment. Run anything heavy in the background with Monitor and no timeout.
Role: read dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md and its rules from main, and follow them exactly. Fetch the PR head with `git fetch origin ac96f4c35659dd3c99f6155b6290cf437ce7742f`; the PR body is in the PR. Verify each claim adversarially: mutate the fix and check the tests fail, and check every figure in the body at this head. Check that it merges with origin/main (`git merge-tree --write-tree`) and read CI on this head from the check-runs API.
Output: in a fresh directory of your own (`W=$(mktemp -d)`), write verdict.md, whose first line is exactly `Fix review: merge ac96f4c35659dd3c99f6155b6290cf437ce7742f` or `Fix review: blocked ac96f4c35659dd3c99f6155b6290cf437ce7742f <class>: <reason>` (no brackets; the class is lower-case letters and dashes), in the format the role file gives, then a blank line, then `bus-nonce: 212a1c44640251bec096b192f77b6627`, then the body in sections. A blocked verdict's block goes under `## Block`. Each finding this PR does not settle (a defect, a surviving mutant, a deferral, a follow-up, a task owed after the merge) is its own bullet under `## Findings` ending in its own `Carry: <GROUP> | #<issue> | O<n> | dismissed: <reason>` (finding-propagation.md). Everything else (RESULT lines, re-runs, CI state, figures you could not re-derive) goes under `## Evidence`: tools/audit/carry_audit.py reads no item there as a finding unless it hands something on (deferred, for a later, follow-up, minor, advisory, residual, still has to, not blocking ...; a check that does not block is evidence only in the clause saying it is not a required check and does not block, never in the rest of its sentence: a nit or defect beside it is a finding), and the merge train parks a verdict holding a finding with no `Carry:`. Put the evidence files in `ev/` beside it, and make at least one file under `ev/` contain the full 40-hex head `ac96f4c35659dd3c99f6155b6290cf437ce7742f` (e.g. `ev/HEAD.txt` holding the head you reviewed, beside your command output): bus.sh refuses a verdict whose `ev/` names no head. Do NOT run bus.sh: its dispatch record lives on the orchestrator's machine, which publishes the verdict there (cloud_relay.sh). Return the verdict on a probe ref, and push nothing else; this builds one parentless commit with a private index and touches no branch of your checkout: `R=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel); G=$(git rev-parse --absolute-git-dir); mkdir -p $W/pr && cp -r $W/verdict.md $W/ev $W/pr/ && cd $W/pr && T=$(GIT_DIR=$G GIT_INDEX_FILE=$W/idx GIT_WORK_TREE=$W/pr sh -c 'git add -A -f . && git write-tree') && C=$(GIT_DIR=$G git -c user.name=seat -c user.email=seat@users.noreply.github.com commit-tree $T -m "verdict 2844 ac96f4c35659dd3c99f6155b6290cf437ce7742f") && git -C $R push -q origin $C:refs/heads/probe/rev-2844-212a1c44`. That ref is the return signal. Do not post comments, approve or merge.
Never write to any branch except your return refs. Never work around a hook or a refusal; report it in your result instead.

Brief (snapshotted when this payload was rendered):
FULL REVIEW of #2844 (roster batch 16), head ac96f4c35659dd3c99f6155b6290cf437ce7742f, against dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md (origin/main) from a detached worktree at the head SHA. The pull request changes dev/programme/rosters/wave-r10-groups.json (5 roster ops (4 append-carry, 1 set-stage R10-PLAN-ISSUES-CHART done), the range origin/main..d373c351 of fix/audit-r10-roster-pr (commits e580153ed a1cefa714 8e61c60c8 02f265488 d373c351) of the roster branch) and its delivery row. Check:
- every op in the five roster_edit commits cites a merged ruling or a merged PR (in the commit message, the op's note, or the group's brief); name any op that cites neither.
- no carry is dropped without being re-routed: for each carry removed by the batch, the same text appears on a live group's roster entry, or the body dismisses it with a reason and a destination. Carry_audit (tools/audit/carry_audit.py) on the body at this head.
- the delivery row dev/programme/delivery/2844.md is present in the three-dot diff against origin/main.
- node tools/policy/brief_lint.mjs on the merged tree prints 0 errors. Run it and report its output.
Also check the merge with origin/main is clean (git merge-tree --write-tree) and read CI on this head from the check-runs API.
Output: write verdict.md in a fresh directory of your own. Its first line is exactly "Fix review: merge ac96f4c35659dd3c99f6155b6290cf437ce7742f" or "Fix review: blocked ac96f4c35659dd3c99f6155b6290cf437ce7742f <class>: <reason>" (no brackets; class lower-case letters and dashes). Then a blank line, then "bus-nonce: 212a1c44640251bec096b192f77b6627". Then the body in sections: a blocked verdict's block under "## Block"; each finding this PR does not settle is its own bullet under "## Findings" ending in "Carry: <GROUP> | #<issue> | O<n> | dismissed: <reason>". Everything else goes under "## Evidence". Put evidence under ev/, with a file holding the full 40-hex head ac96f4c35659dd3c99f6155b6290cf437ce7742f. Return the verdict on a probe ref: the commit is built with a private index as the role file gives, then pushed to refs/heads/probe/rev-2844-212a1c44. Do NOT run bus.sh. Do not post comments, approve or merge. Write no Claude Code footer, no Co-Authored-By or Claude-Session trailer and no claude.ai session link in any commit or comment. Do not name any path under a home directory in the verdict.
